item.title: Residents get revved up over proposed arterial road in West Brant
item.description: About 300 people attended a public information meeting at Assumption College School on Thursday to learn more about the city's plans to build an arterial road that would link West Brant to the northern part of the city.

item.title: Parker's Project leader calls for compassion following woman's arrest in 20-year-old cold case
item.description: The woman who leads Parker's Project hopes the community will go forward with compassion and support following the arrest of a woman in connection with the death of a newborn more than 20 years ago.

item.title: Report sets plan to address substance use, mental health challenges in Haldimand, Norfolk, Mississaugas of the Credit
item.description: Expanding naloxone distribution, strengthening withdrawal management services, and reducing stigma in healthcare settings are among 11 actions in a new report aimed at reducing the harm associated with substance use and mental health challenges.

item.title: Simcoe Little Theatre brings CHESS: The Musical in Concert to its stage in March
